marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 25 knots diminishing to northwest 15 near
midnight and to light late Sunday morning. Wind becoming south 15 Sunday
evening. Scattered showers ending Sunday morning. Fog patches
forming Sunday morning. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less late
overnight.<br/>
